## Which file do I download?

| Your computer | Download | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** (recommended) | `Moonfang-3D-Setup-<version>.exe` | Double-click it in your Downloads folder and follow the installer. It starts Moonfang 3D at the end and adds Desktop and Start menu shortcuts. |
| Windows, without installing | `Moonfang-3D-Portable-<version>.exe` | Double-click it in your Downloads folder. Nothing is installed; keep the file somewhere handy and start Moonfang 3D from it each time. |
| **Linux** | `Moonfang-3D-Linux-<version>-x86_64.AppImage` | Right-click → Properties → allow running as a program (or `chmod +x` it), then double-click it. |

You don't need the **Source code** files; they're for developers.

### Starting it for the first time on Windows

The beta isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"**. Click **More info**, then
**Run anyway**. This only happens the first time.

Moonfang 3D works fully offline. Your work is saved automatically on your own computer.
Found a problem? **Help → Report a Bug** in the app.
